name: M5.PolynomialIndicator.conditional_indicator
statement: ∀ (a b F : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (N : ℕ), 0 < N → F.Monic → F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N → F ∣ a → F ∣ b → M5.PolynomialIndicator.factorExclusionSum a b F N = (if M5.completeSignature a b N = F then 1 else 0)
context:
theorem M5.PolynomialIndicator.residual_factors_regular : ∀ (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (N : ℕ), 0 < N → F.Monic → F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N → ∀ p ∈ M5.PolynomialExclusion.residualFactors (M5.cyclicModulus N) F, p.Monic ∧ Irreducible p := by
  classical
  intro F N hN hF hdiv p hp
  have hq : M5.cyclicModulus N / F ≠ 0 :=
    M5.PolynomialExclusion.cyclic_quotient_nonzero F N hN hF hdiv
  have hmem : p ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (M5.cyclicModulus N / F) := by
    simpa [M5.PolynomialExclusion.residualFactors, hq] using hp
  have hirr : Irreducible p :=
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid.irreducible_of_normalized_factor p hmem
  exact ⟨M5.Signature.binary_monic p hirr.ne_zero, hirr⟩
guidance: Instantiate M5.FiniteExclusion.exclusion_indicator at residual factors and bad p := decide (F*p ∣ a ∧ F*p ∣ b). For each subset, use M5.FactorProduct.product_event_iff for both a and b. Subset regularity comes from residual_factors_regular. Then use M5.PolynomialExclusion.finite_factor_criterion. FiniteExclusion.exclusionSum and factorExclusionSum are definitions. Use classical. Preserve multiplicities in F*p. Return tactic lines without leading by; do not change target.
